info.name: Student Registration API tests
info.description: Part 2 contract tests, Part 3 baseline drift guard, Part 4 independent dynamic scenarios, and three multi-step workflows. Populate baselineContract from contract/openapi.json before running the drift guard.

exec: pm.test('Baseline contract variable is populated', function () { pm.expect(raw, 'Paste contract/openapi.json into collection variable baselineContract').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
for (const [prop, def] of Object.entries(props)) propertyTypes[prop] = def.type || (def.$ref ? '$ref:' + def.$ref : 'unspecified');

item.name: List courses by instructorId with no match

exec: pm.test('List courses by unmatched instructorId returns an empty list', function () { pm.expect(H.body()).to.eql([]); });
pm.test('Update course returns the new name', function () { const b = H.body(); pm.expect(H.isObj(b) ? b.name : undefined).to.equal('P2 Course Updated'); });
pm.test('Add student puts exactly one student on the roster', function () { const b = H.body(); pm.expect(H.isObj(b) && Array.isArray(b.roster) && b.roster.length === 1, H.notJson()).to.be.true; });
H.err('Add a student who is already on the roster', 409);
pm.test('Get enrollment body is an integer', function () { pm.expect(Number.isInteger(H.body())).to.be.true; });
pm.test('Get enrollment equals the roster size of 1', function () { pm.expect(H.body()).to.equal(1); });

pm.test("List student's courses includes the enrolled course", function () { pm.expect(Array.isArray(a) && a.some(function (c) { return c.id == pm.collectionVariables.get('p2_courseId'); })).to.be.true; });
pm.test('Remove student leaves the roster empty', function () { const b = H.body(); pm.expect(H.isObj(b) && Array.isArray(b.roster) && b.roster.length === 0, H.notJson()).to.be.true; });

item.name: D15 - Lifecycle - deleting student removes roster membership
Course roster is empty after student deletion

exec: const b=pm.response.json(); pm.test('Deleted student removed from roster',()=>pm.expect((b.roster||[]).length).to.equal(0));

item.name: D16 - Lifecycle - deleting course preserves students
Student still exists after course deletion

exec: const H=eval(pm.collectionVariables.get('helper')); H.ok('Student remains after course deletion',200,'StudentResponse'); pm.test('Student has no remaining course name',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.json().courses).to.be.an('array').that.is.empty);
